_audit.CURRENT_GRADE: Grade C — T0 establishes baseline only

methodology: Visual benchmark assessed via BrightData SERP research on store descriptions, review excerpts, and industry analyst visual assessments. Direct screenshot capture stored in T0-visual-benchmark-corpus/.

delta_verify_grade_rubric.A: 3D rendered environments, physically-integrated UI, particle systems, post-processing, 60fps target
delta_verify_grade_rubric.B: High-quality 2D or partial 3D, polished UI, some effects
delta_verify_grade_rubric.C: Flat or basic 2D, minimal effects, functional but not premium

games.name: Royal Match
games.grade_rationale: High-quality 2D with polished character art and smooth animations. No 3D environment. Clean UI. Would be Grade A with 3D environment integration.
key_visual_differentiators: Episodic castle renovation loop keeps context fresh

games.name: Monopoly GO
games.ui_density: high — board game map + slot reel + event banners simultaneous
games.grade_rationale: 3D dice and token elements, strong IP visual language. UI density is high and can feel overwhelming. Not a cohesive 3D world.
key_visual_differentiators: Board game perspective unique in space

games.name: Coin Master
games.ui_density: medium — slot machine dominant, village beneath
games.grade_rationale: Cartoon 2D aesthetic, functional but dated visually. Slot machine dominant. Not premium by 2025 standards.
key_visual_differentiators: Strong color contrast for casual audience

games.name: Merge Mansion
games.ui_density: medium — merge grid dominant with narrative overlay
games.grade_rationale: Strong narrative integration, sophisticated palette for the genre. 2D but polished. Character-driven aesthetic earns B.
key_visual_differentiators: Mystery narrative tension sets visual mood
Mature palette vs typical casual bright colors

games.name: Gardenscapes
games.ui_density: low to medium — garden meta clean, match grid busy
games.grade_rationale: Industry standard for match-3 visual polish. Character art quality high. Garden renovation gives visual progression context.
key_visual_differentiators: Garden renovation provides persistent visual payoff

games.name: WOW Vegas
games.ui_density: high — lobby grid of 1500+ slots, heavy banner promotion
games.grade_rationale: Standard social casino visual template. No differentiated aesthetic. Functional but indistinguishable from competitors.
key_visual_differentiators: Dark premium aesthetic vs casual-bright competitors

games.name: Screwdom
games.grade_rationale: 3D rendered puzzle elements in otherwise 2D casual wrapper. The 3D depth distinguishes it from flat competitors. Q1 2025 top hybrid-casual performer.
key_visual_differentiators: 3D rendering in a category dominated by 2D

games.name: LuckyLand Slots
games.ui_density: medium — cleaner lobby than WOW Vegas
games.grade_rationale: Standard slot-lobby aesthetic. Lucky charm theme is differentiated but not premium. Functional.
key_visual_differentiators: Cleaner lobby layout than some competitors

games.name: Jackpot Party Casino
games.ui_density: very high — aggressive promotion banners, multiple CTAs
games.grade_rationale: Dated aesthetic. Very high UI density creates friction. No meaningful visual differentiation.
key_visual_differentiators: Large established player base creates social proof signals

games.name: Royal Kingdom
games.ui_density: low — clean continuation of Royal Match aesthetic
games.grade_rationale: Evolution of Royal Match visual language with added drama (siege battles). Still 2D but higher production value than predecessor. $207.5M IAP in 2025.
key_visual_differentiators: Darker, more dramatic tone vs Royal Match
Battle meta adds visual conflict tension

far_nzy_gap_analysis.current_assessment: Grade C — FAR_NZY's 3D physics-based environment (Rapier3D + Three.js) positions it structurally above all Grade C competitors and on par with or above Grade B competitors if visual polish is achieved.
far_nzy_gap_analysis.path_to_grade_a: Gothic Hacker Neon UI over Organic Vegas 3D backend per 3libras/the_visual_layer.md — the 3D physically-integrated aesthetic is a genuine visual differentiator vs all benchmarked competitors. No direct competitor has achieved Grade A in casino+puzzle hybrid category.
far_nzy_gap_analysis.biggest_risk: UI density — social casino players expect high information density; FAR_NZY must maintain Gothic Hacker Neon clarity at high information loads.
